title: Tiny, cute balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='75%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ec4'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ff4d88'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d61f61'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='24' ry='28' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='29' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#ffd6e6' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='52' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff8fb8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- knot -->
  <path d='M46 67 L50 74 L54 67 Z' fill='#c41a56'/>
  <!-- string -->
  <path d='M50 74 C46 82 55 88 49 96' stroke='#9c6b7e' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tiny smiles face, cute -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='37' r='2.6' fill='#3a0d1e'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='37' r='2.6' fill='#3a0d1e'/>
  <path d='M44 46 Q50 51 56 46' stroke='#3a0d1e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='44' r='2.6' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.9'/>

</svg>
